scientific_basis: VAL A:1031 is the final observed polymer residue of selected chain A.
PDB2PQR 3.7.1 adds OXT while constructing the explicit pH 7.4 AMBER terminal state.
The residue is 24.780263719339224 angstrom from crystallographic M5V A:1101.
hard_limits: Only the exact A|VAL|1031||OXT identity is authorized.
The input residue must still be the final polymer residue of chain A and must not already contain OXT.
Every other added or removed heavy atom remains a hard failure.
